purpose._: DRAFT for Matt to edit 2026-08-27. The six questions, answered for this page. Everything else in this file describes HOW the page is built; this describes WHAT IT IS FOR, and it is the thing to argue with. Build and review both read this.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. This is a discovery shell, not a brochure: the visitor arrived wanting to look at houses, and the page's whole job is to get them looking within one screen.
purpose.primaryAction: See homes -> the regional search. ONE primary. Every other ask on the page is secondary and must look it.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell), NOT a repeat visitor (they arrive on a saved search).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now, and what does it cost?
Where is 'here' -- what are the towns and what do they cost?
Is this a good time to buy or sell?
Who are you and can I trust you?

alsoWins: homes for sale bend redmond sisters sunriver
searchIntent.whyThisPageCanWin: It publishes live inventory, per-town medians and a traced market verdict on one crawlable page. Aggregators publish inventory without the local verdict; the other Bend brokerages publish the verdict without live inventory.
searchIntent.whatItOwesSEO: One H1 carrying the head term; the town names as real links with real figures; the market answer in text, not only in a chart; JSON-LD that matches the visible figures.

dataAvailable: live active listings with photo, price, address, beds/baths/sqft, lat/lng
per-town active count and median list price
the leftover market row: median list, pending, closed 30d, sale-to-list, months of supply, days to contract, median close, price cuts
Google reviews; the three brokers; the approved Bend flyover clip
notThisPagesJob: Refining by property type. Condo / townhome / land / farm / commercial / business belong to search, which exists to filter. Eight enumerated type sections is a filter UI rendered as page content.
Being the market report. /housing-market owns the full figure set; the homepage owes the ANSWER and a door.
Being the about page. /about and /team own the brokerage story.

openDefects._: Open against this page's purpose as of 2026-08-27.
items: The hero states no inventory figure while the count line sits below it, so the first screen carries no number on a page whose head term is inventory.

competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow and Redfin on LOCAL TRUTH (Matt 2026-08-27). They publish inventory; they do not publish a local verdict, and they never show what produced a number. This page publishes both on one crawlable screen: the live Central Oregon active count and per-town medians, AND the buyer-or-seller answer with the trace and the stamp under it. The other Bend brokerages have the local credibility and static pages -- no live figures at all. So the edge is the intersection: the only Central Oregon homepage where the inventory is live, the market answer is stated in words, and both name the query that produced them. No aggregator publishes the trace under the number.
sectionOrder: V3Stage #hero -- the flyover clip, the H1 carrying the head term, ONE primary: See homes
HomeHomesField -- the houses and the map, with the live regional count as the caption
V3Ledger #towns -- each town's active count and median list price
V3Instrument #market -- the buyer-or-seller ANSWER with its trace and stamp, and a door to the full report
HomeAlertSheet -- renders id=alerts internally; THE ASK, where the browsing ends (was last on the page until 2026-08-27)
V3Quiet #reviews -- Google reviews, as proof after the ask
AboutFaces -- the three brokers, as proof
section #sell -- the seller ask, last on purpose: a different audience, and /sell is its page
